draftStructure.courseTitle: OpenCV in Computer Vision: A Practical Intermediate Course
draftStructure.courseDescription: A balanced, hands-on journey through classical computer vision with OpenCV in Python — from image fundamentals to feature matching, video analysis, and a touch of deep-learning integration.

modules.title: Foundations of OpenCV and Digital Images

lessons.title: Course Orientation and Environment Setup
lessons.summary: Install OpenCV for Python, verify your toolchain, and tour the project layout you'll use throughout the course.

lessons.title: How Computers See: Pixels, Channels, and Color Spaces
lessons.summary: Understand image representation as NumPy arrays and explore RGB, BGR, grayscale, and HSV color spaces.

lessons.title: Reading, Displaying, and Writing Images
lessons.summary: Practice loading images from disk, showing them in windows, and saving results with cv2.imread, imshow, and imwrite.

lessons.title: Drawing and Annotating Images
lessons.summary: Draw shapes, lines, and text on images to build overlays for debugging and visualization.

lessons.title: Image Arithmetic and Bitwise Operations
lessons.summary: Combine images using addition, blending, masks, and bitwise AND/OR/NOT for compositing tasks.

lessons.title: Geometric Transformations: Resize, Rotate, Translate
lessons.summary: Apply affine transforms and warpAffine to scale, rotate, and shift images while preserving content.

lessons.title: Perspective Transforms and Image Warping
lessons.summary: Use four-point perspective warps to rectify documents and tilted scenes into top-down views.

lessons.title: Smoothing and Blurring Filters
lessons.summary: Compare averaging, Gaussian, median, and bilateral filters and learn when each one is appropriate.

lessons.title: Thresholding Techniques
lessons.summary: Binarize images using global, Otsu, and adaptive thresholding to isolate regions of interest.

lessons.title: Morphological Operations
lessons.summary: Apply erosion, dilation, opening, and closing to clean up binary masks and shapes.

lessons.title: Image Gradients with Sobel and Scharr
lessons.summary: Compute first-order gradients to highlight intensity changes and prepare images for edge detection.

lessons.title: Canny Edge Detection in Depth
lessons.summary: Walk through the Canny pipeline and tune its thresholds for clean, connected edge maps.

lessons.title: Finding and Drawing Contours
lessons.summary: Extract contours from binary images and visualize their hierarchy with findContours and drawContours.

lessons.title: Contour Properties and Shape Analysis
lessons.summary: Measure area, perimeter, bounding boxes, convex hulls, and moments to classify shapes.

lessons.title: Histograms and Histogram Equalization
lessons.summary: Analyze pixel distributions and apply equalization and CLAHE to enhance contrast.

lessons.title: Corner Detection with Harris and Shi-Tomasi
lessons.summary: Identify corner-like keypoints and understand why corners are stable features for tracking.

lessons.title: Keypoint Descriptors: SIFT, ORB, and AKAZE
lessons.summary: Compute and visualize local feature descriptors and compare their trade-offs.

lessons.title: Feature Matching with Brute-Force and FLANN
lessons.summary: Match descriptors between images and filter matches using ratio tests for robustness.

lessons.title: Homography Estimation and Image Stitching
lessons.summary: Use matched features and RANSAC to estimate homographies and stitch overlapping images into a panorama.

lessons.title: Template Matching for Object Localization
lessons.summary: Locate small patterns inside larger images with normalized cross-correlation template matching.

lessons.title: Working with Video Streams and Webcams
lessons.summary: Capture frames from video files and live cameras using VideoCapture and write annotated output.

lessons.title: Background Subtraction for Motion Detection
lessons.summary: Detect moving objects in static-camera footage using MOG2 and KNN background subtractors.

lessons.title: Optical Flow: Lucas-Kanade and Farneback
lessons.summary: Estimate sparse and dense pixel motion between frames to track objects and analyze movement.

lessons.title: Object Tracking with OpenCV Trackers
lessons.summary: Use built-in trackers like CSRT and KCF to follow a selected object across video frames.

modules.title: Applied Computer Vision and Modern Integrations

lessons.title: Face Detection with Haar Cascades
lessons.summary: Run classical cascade classifiers to detect faces and eyes in images and video.

lessons.title: Camera Calibration and Undistortion
lessons.summary: Calibrate a camera with a chessboard pattern and remove lens distortion from captured images.

lessons.title: Bridging to Deep Learning with cv2.dnn
lessons.summary: Load a pretrained model through the OpenCV DNN module and compare it briefly with classical approaches.

lessons.title: Capstone: Building a Mini Vision Pipeline
lessons.summary: Combine preprocessing, feature extraction, and tracking into a small end-to-end project of your choice.
